name: bookkeeping_advance_repayments
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_advance_repayments (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   advance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_advances(id),   repaid_on TEXT NOT NULL,   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp > 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   note TEXT , request_key TEXT, cash_transaction_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_cash_transactions(id))

name: bookkeeping_loans
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_loans (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   payer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   loaned_on TEXT NOT NULL,   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp > 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   note TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , request_key TEXT)

name: bookkeeping_loan_repayments
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_loan_repayments (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   loan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_loans(id),   repaid_on TEXT NOT NULL,   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp > 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   note TEXT , request_key TEXT, cash_transaction_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_cash_transactions(id))

name: bookkeeping_fines
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_fines (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   payer_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   household_id TEXT REFERENCES households(id),   event_on TEXT NOT NULL,   fine_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gorol',   amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp >= 0),   paid_rp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(paid_rp >= 0),   paid_on TEXT,   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'belum',   note TEXT,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , request_key TEXT)

name: bookkeeping_cash_transactions
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_cash_transactions (   id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   occurred_on TEXT NOT NULL,   payer_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_payers(id),   household_id TEXT REFERENCES households(id),   transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL,   category TEXT,   debit_rp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(debit_rp >= 0),   credit_rp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(credit_rp >= 0),   status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',   note TEXT,   source_payment_id TEXT REFERENCES bookkeeping_payments(id),   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, payment_method TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Cash', extra_note TEXT,   CHECK(NOT (debit_rp > 0 AND credit_rp > 0)) )

name: bookkeeping_cash_source_links
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_cash_source_links (   cash_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bookkeeping_cash_transactions(id),   source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('iuran','denda','cicilan_pinjaman')),   source_id TEXT NOT NULL,   created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,   UNIQUE (source_kind, source_id) )

name: bookkeeping_dp_cash_links
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_dp_cash_links(request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,source_type TEXT NOT NULL,source_id TEXT NOT NULL,cash_transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES bookkeeping_cash_transactions(id))

name: bookkeeping_fine_payments
sql: CREATE TABLE bookkeeping_fine_payments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,fine_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bookkeeping_fines(id),paid_on TEXT NOT NULL,amount_rp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_rp>0),status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aktif',note TEXT,request_key TEXT UNIQUE,cash_transaction_id TEXT UNIQUE)

trg_dp_fine_closed_year
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_dp_fine_closed_year
BEFORE INSERT ON bookkeeping_fines
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookkeeping_year_archives WHERE fiscal_year=CAST(substr(NEW.event_on,1,4) AS INTEGER) AND status IN ('ditutup','terkunci','final'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'closed-financial-year'); END
